decisions.claim_boundary: Do not claim active diagnosis itself.
decisions.reason: Active diagnosability is established prior art; the testable incremental residual is diagnosability composed with responsibility-scoped epistemic mutation authority.

decisions.claim_boundary: Do not claim conservative bandits or safe exploration as novelty.
decisions.reason: Conservative/safe contextual bandits and safe exploration for IR are established; only the composition with P2 route identity, censoring and route/task authority is worth testing.

decisions.claim_boundary: Do not claim lenses, cycle consistency, transportability, or scientific obstruction in isolation.
decisions.reason: Bidirectional lenses and scientific obstruction/transport already exist; the incremental question is whether typed scientific round-trip/cycle checks reduce unsafe integration on expert gold.

decisions.claim_boundary: Planner output can never grant scientific authority.
decisions.reason: Proof-carrying governance and structured defeater management are close prior work. The planner is retained only as an efficiency helper under unchanged protected authority semantics.

decisions.claim_boundary: Do not claim anytime-valid acceptance or validated self-evolution alone.
decisions.reason: Anytime-valid acceptance and validated self-evolution are already direct prior work. The surviving incremental question is non-compensatory replay/fresh/protected evidence with custody, negative history and host-only promotion.
